sloka: तच्छ्रूयतां महाप्राज्ञ सर्वशास्त्रविशारद ।वचनं मम वित्तेश यद्ब्रवीति दशाननः ।। ७.११.२८ ॥
transliteration: tacchrūyatāṁ mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada ।vacanaṁ mama vitteśa yadbravīti daśānanaḥ ।। 7.11.28 ॥

translations.english: O greatly wise one, O expert in all scriptures, O lord of wealth, please listen to my message, which Dashanana (Ravana) conveys.
